verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell is a workstation GPU. User-defined, event-triggered automation rules are a workflow or SaaS capability and outside this product category, so the question is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships such a rules engine. cuML's automatic GPU/CPU fallback is an internal library behavior, not user-defined event rules, so it does not make the axis applicable.
